info.name: Internship Backend — notes
info.description:
A Google-Keep-style notes/todos API with checklists, over REST and GraphQL.

Send **Auth > Login** first: its test script stores `token` and `refreshToken` as collection variables and every other request picks them up automatically.

Todos belong to their owner, so every list here is the seeded login’s own - 8 NOTES, 2 ARCHIVED, 4 TRASH out of the 60 rows in the database.

variable.description: Where the backend is listening. Point it somewhere else to run the same requests against another instance.
Access token. Filled in by Auth > Login.
Refresh token. Filled in by Auth > Login.

request.description:
Exchanges credentials for an access/refresh pair. The test script stores both in collection variables, so every other request below is authenticated - run this first.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

Trades the refresh token for a new pair, consuming the old one. Rotation is enforced: replaying a spent token revokes the whole session family.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

Creates an account that can log in immediately - and starts with no todos at all, since todos belong to their owner.

Callable without a token. Expected: 201.

currentPassword is always required. Changing the password revokes every other session and returns a fresh token pair; changing only the email returns none.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

Revokes the refresh token in the database and blacklists the access token in memory. Unguarded on purpose: it must work with an expired token.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

A page of the caller’s own todos: { items, total, limit, offset }. Without status it returns NOTES; the filter and the page combine.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

items is optional; each entry needs only text, and ids are assigned per todo starting at 1.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 201.

variable.description: a todo owned by the seeded login

request.description:
Sending items replaces the whole checklist - it is not a merge. Leave it out to edit only the text.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

variable.description: a todo owned by the seeded login

request.description:
Moves a note between NOTES, ARCHIVED and TRASH. Anything else is a 400 - the column has a CHECK constraint behind it.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

variable.description: a todo owned by the seeded login

request.description:
Permanent, whatever the status. Owner only.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 204.

Permanently deletes every TRASH todo of the caller. 404 when the trash is already empty.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 204.

Moves every ARCHIVED todo back to NOTES and returns the restored rows. 404 when there were none.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

variable.description: an item id inside that todo

request.description:
Flips one item and returns the whole todo. itemId is the id inside that todo, not a global one.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

400 when the todo has no checklist at all.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

Applies one background to all of the caller’s todos and returns them. Per-todo backgrounds are GraphQL-only (updateTodoBackground).

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

The user the access token belongs to.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

Profile fields only. Email and password move through PUT /api/account, which asks for the current password.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

Stores nothing and returns a made-up URL, so an upload flow has something to render. Attach any file to the form-data body.

Callable without a token. Expected: 201.

Drops everything and reseeds - including sessions, so every token stops working and accounts made with signup are gone.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

The collection you are reading, regenerated by the running server. Re-import it after upgrading the package to pick up new endpoints; baseUrl comes back pointing at whichever host served it.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

item.name: GraphQL — queries
item.description: Every `Query` field in the schema, one request each.

graphql.query:
query Me {
  me {
    id
    username
    email
    profileImage
    firstName
    secondName
    description
    lastLogin
    creationDate
    modifiedDate
  }
}

request.description:
Generated from the GraphQL schema: every field of the return type is selected, so trim what you do not need.
